name: Caltrops
summary: Utilize: cover a 5-ft square; DC 15 Dex save or 1 Piercing damage and Speed 0.
text: As a Utilize action, you scatter the Caltrops from their bag over a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of you. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Gathering the Caltrops back up takes 10 minutes.
